assertions.claim: Rabies once symptomatic is almost 100% fatal; washing plus vaccination is the only path.
assertions.cn_span: 狂犬病一旦发病病死率几乎 100%，冲洗加疫苗是唯一的路

assertions.claim: Alternate soapy water and running clean water for 15 minutes, get vaccinated the same day.
assertions.cn_span: 先用肥皂水和流动清水交替冲 15 分钟，当天去打疫苗

assertions.claim: Transdermal bite or licking of broken skin is category III exposure, adding passive immunization.
assertions.cn_span: 贯穿性咬伤、破皮处被舔属于三级暴露，还要加打被动免疫制剂

assertions.claim: 'Household, vaccinated' does not change management; category is set by the wound, not the dog's origin.
assertions.cn_span: 「家养的、打过针的」不改变处置，级别按伤口定，不按狗的来历定

assertions.claim: Light bite of intact skin or scratch without blood is category II — vaccination needed.
assertions.cn_span: 裸露皮肤被轻咬、无出血抓伤为 II 级暴露要打疫苗

assertions.claim: WHO: ~59,000 rabies deaths globally per year, 99% transmitted by dogs.
assertions.cn_span: 全球每年约 5.9 万人死于狂犬病，99% 由狗传播

assertions.claim: The 10-day observation rule only decides whether to stop the shots, not whether to start them; don't bandage the wound yourself; wild animals and bats handled the same way.
assertions.cn_span: 十日观察法只能决定是否停针，不能决定要不要开始打
